subject: Pilot runway shortfall: conversion options and one-time surge waiver
messages:
From: Caroline Ng <caroline@lumenai.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@lumenai.com>, LumenAI Procurement <procurement@lumenai.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot status and runway – shortfall this week

Hi Rishi,

Quick note from the engineering team: we've hit the pilot burn cap faster than expected because of a block of high-concurrency tests. We're at ~85% of anticipated usage for the 30-day timebox after only 18 days. The team needs either additional tokens/hours or an extension to validate the final integration (we have two feature gates left).

Options we'd consider:
- 10 additional days on the current timebox with the same throughput, or
- A one-time top-up of 200k tokens at a discounted rate to cover surge testing.

Procurement also asked whether there's a short-term billing option rather than an amendment (they want to avoid a long legal cycle). Attached is our usage snapshot.

Can Redwood provide a short-term concession? Any chance of a limited waiver on the surge fee if we commit to convert to a Dedicated plan within 90 days?

Thanks,
Caroline
VP Product, LumenAI

Attachments: June_usage_report.csv (csv)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Caroline Ng <caroline@lumenai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot status and runway – shortfall this week

Caroline — thanks for the heads up and the report. Sorry to hear testing spiked unexpectedly. We have three pragmatic options that keep procurement simple:

1) Timebox extension (preferred for validation): +10 days on the current pilot with the same token allotment, billed as an addendum (minimal legal language). No price change.

2) Top-up credits: 200k tokens at a 20% discount off standard trial top-up pricing, invoiced immediately. No contract amendment required — we treat it as a billable add-on to the current pilot.

3) Surge waiver + conversion commitment: one-time waiver of the standard surge surcharge if LumenAI signs a Dedicated pilot conversion agreement (term sheet) within 90 days. Waiver limited to the current spike and requires an email commitment from procurement; legal to follow but can be lightweight (term sheet + SOW).

Operational notes: option 1 is fastest; option 2 is simplest for procurement; option 3 gives the best financial outcome for you but we need a clear conversion signal.

I've looped in Laura for finance and Priyom for any packaging nuance. If you want a draft addendum or a short invoice for the credit purchase, we can get that out today.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_amendment_draft.docx (outline)
From: Caroline Ng <caroline@lumenai.com>

Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot status and runway – shortfall this week

Thanks Rishi — that framing helps. Two follow-ups from our side:

- Procurement prefers option 2 (top-up credits) to avoid any amendment chase. If you can send an invoice for the discounted 200k tokens we can route it quickly.
- However, Product really wants option 1 if it's frictionless (we'd rather have more time than an invoice). Would Redwood be willing to do a 7-day extension as a compromise (instead of 10) with no extra charge, provided we sign the conversion term sheet within 60 days?

If you can confirm a 7-day extension + a 200k credit offer at 15% (instead of 20%) contingent on the 60-day conversion email, procurement will push this through today.

Also copying Evan — can you confirm whether the addendum needs legal or just finance sign-off?

Best,
Caroline

Hi Caroline and team — Laura here from Finance. Appreciate the clear options. We can do the following, approved by revenue ops: 

- 7-day no-cost timebox extension to the current pilot (no legal required; we'll issue a short addendum that is signable by finance only).
- 200k token top-up at 15% discount, invoiced net 30.
- As requested, we will include a conditional clause in the addendum: if LumenAI sends a signed conversion term email within 60 days, Redwood will confirm the one-time waiver of any surge surcharge for this spike. The waiver applies to this top-up/addendum only.

Next steps for us:
1) Rishi will send a short two-paragraph addendum and an invoice for the 200k tokens.
2) Caroline / Procurement to confirm via reply-all that they accept the 7-day extension + the 15% top-up invoice path.
3) After payment or confirmation (Procurement preference), we'll update the pilot in our system and provide a minor amendment ID for tracking.

We will attach the draft addendum and the invoice stub to the HubSpot deal. If you want us to skip the invoice and accept a procurement PO in lieu, we can do that too — let Rishi know.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
